_comment: Where each pitch sits on the club's allocation map, as percentages of
club/images/web/pitch-map.jpg. A session plan writes the club's own zone code
— ![caption](pitch:2b) — and the build pins that team's marker on the spot.
Halves are named as seen standing at the Club House looking out over the
grounds, which is why pitches 1 and 4 divide near/far while 2 and 3 divide
left/right. An unknown code fails the build.
To add a zone: open the map, estimate left/top as percentages from the
top-left corner, and name the pitch and half the way people say them.
_training: Not one of the club's Sunday allocation codes: the floodlit training area, the blue square below Pitch 4. Position estimated from the map itself.
